record.question: Which of the following statement regarding aminoglycoside is FALSE?
options: Do not mix aminoglycosides with any drug in the same syringe/infusion bottle
Do not use aminoglycosides during pregnancy
Use aminoglycosides cautiously in people more than 60 years of age
Do not use aminoglycosides if patient is taking treatment for scabies
record.explanation: Official final key: D — Do not use aminoglycosides if patient is taking treatment for scabies. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 10, printed Q66. Source limitation: The absolute statement that aminoglycosides should never be used during pregnancy is not true in all clinical circumstances; treatment may be justified when benefits outweigh risks. This makes option B an additional false choice alongside the scabies statement. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
